entities.name: Ivana Dojkić

entities.summary: Ivana Dojkić is a Croatian professional basketball player for Reyer Venezia of the Lega Basket Femminile. She previously played for the New York Liberty and the Seattle Storm in the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).
